tasks.spec: ROLE: fix worker for the Mott goal-loop Bland pathway, round 22 - adversarial-audit consolidation. Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills; do not mint, attach, deploy, or call any API. CONTEXT: an adversarial audit at /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workRedTeam/rt-graph-auditor/AUDIT.md (read it in full) confirmed the router-ambiguity class behind this week's live mis-picks, three time-unsafe prompts, and non-exclusive anchor routing; separately, a live regression proved extraction sometimes emits raw anaphoric text ('Monday that week') that only the gateway can resolve deterministically WITH context. THE GATEWAY (lane 50, building in parallel) now accepts an OPTIONAL 'context_date' request field (resolves anaphoric from-text against that date's week) and returns, for anchor searches, a single mutually exclusive 'anchor_route' enum: exact | closest | none | error. Build against those contracts. NOTE: the audit's opt-out finding (#4) is a FALSE POSITIVE - n_suppress_stop and n_suppress_not_me are Bland GLOBAL nodes (isGlobal true) reachable from anywhere; do NOT add edges for them, and say so in DEBUG.md. SOURCES (copy into CWD, then edit): /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD29/gl-round21-fix/ (round-21 draft = v118). THE FIX: (1) CONTEXT_DATE: every availability webhook body adds "context_date": "{{slot_1_start}}" - the contract is now eleven fields (store, from, to, after, before, time_pref, slot_minutes, callID, user_text, user_verbatim, context_date); nothing else in the bodies changes. (2) ROUTE ENUM (audit finding 3): replace n_goal_search_offered_anchor's responsePathways with EXACTLY four exclusive equality triples on anchor_route: 'exact' -> n_gate_1, 'closest' -> n_time_pick_offer, 'none' -> n_goal_ask, 'error' -> n_goal_ask; add responseData mapping anchor_route from $.result.anchor_route; remove the legacy anchor_exact routing rows (keep the anchor_exact responseData mapping for reference). (3) ROUTER DIET (findings 1, 5, 6): on n_goal_response, (a) MERGE the correction edge and the new-preference edge into ONE edge to n_goal_search whose label unions both intents ('states or corrects to a different day, date, week, or weekday than offered - including replies beginning with no, actually, or I meant'); (b) REMOVE the clock-time acceptance clause from both gate labels (they return to 'takes only the first/second opening offered' - a named clock time ALWAYS takes the named-time anchor route); (c) add explicit exclusions to the broad labels so siblings are disjoint: the offered-time edge excludes 'latest/end of day' AND 'naming a time to take'; the named-time edge excludes 'after/before-hour windows'; the generic-latest edge keeps its NAMED-day scope. Net n_goal_response outbound edges must be at most 8. Apply the same disjointness pass to n_goal_ask (finding 5: the broad search label explicitly excludes latest/end-of-day and near-a-clock asks) and n_time_pick_offer (finding 6: separate 'different day/date' from 'different time on this date' cleanly). (4) TIME-SILENT SUPPORTS (finding 2): n_mixed_intent, n_office, and n_faq must never speak a clock time: remove any 'naming the openings' instruction, remove any slot templates, and add to each prompt a block starting with the exact marker 'TIME-SILENT:' stating they must not state any clock time or date; n_mixed_intent refers to 'the opening you selected'; n_office and n_faq route the patient back to scheduling with a question only. (5) Everything else from rounds 6-21 unchanged - all prompt guard blocks stay. (6) VALIDATOR: add ASSERTION 22 keeping 1-21 intact: context_date present in every availability body (contract list updated to eleven fields); the offered-anchor routes on the four exclusive anchor_route triples with the exact targets above and no legacy anchor_exact rows; n_goal_response has at most 8 outbound edges, exactly one edge to n_goal_search, and gate labels free of clock-time clauses; n_mixed_intent/n_office/n_faq contain TIME-SILENT and no slot templates. Structured FAIL citing 'assertion 22'; must PASS your draft and FAIL the untouched round-21 draft at /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD29/gl-round21-fix/pathway-goalloop-draft.json citing assertion 22. (7) build_goalloop.py regenerates deterministically; fixture-conformant.json updated. (8) DEBUG.md: each audit finding addressed (or downgraded, for the global-node false positive), the changes, regeneration command; mention extract/prompt/compress context as before.
